# `unknown-comptime-member`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `@hasField` or `@hasDecl` checks that are always false, and `@field`
lookups that cannot succeed, for a resolved analyzed type shape.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Dead comptime branches often indicate a misspelled member or stale compatibility
check.

## When it fires

In Zig 0.17, `@hasDecl` sees public declarations only, including when the check
is in the declaration's own file. `@hasField` checks fields; local `@field`
lookups may still access private declarations.

It applies only when the container shape is known and no `usingnamespace` or
unresolved declaration can add the member.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const Point = struct { x: i32, y: i32 };

const has = @hasField(Point, "z");
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#comptime>
